newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Islamic bank extends $30 mln to Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Islamic bank extends $30 mln to Lebanon.

text.p: The Islamic Development Bank (IDB) said on Sunday it was extending a $30 million loan to Lebanon to finance an educational project.

Under two agreements signed on Saturday, the bank would give Lebanon $22.2 million to finance the purchase of equipment for 31 new schools and another $7.8 million loan to partly finance building them, an IDB statement said.
It said the total cost of the project would be around $102 million. The rest would be financed by the Lebanese government and Kuwait-based Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development.
The Jeddah-based IDB was set up in 1975 to provide soft loans and credits to help boost trade exchanges between Islamic states.
